conditions.tools: Full DeepDeck default tools including Chrome DevTools MCP; only WebMCP changes.
conditions.efficiency: Only comparable pairs passing both scorers. Token totals include input, output, cache reads and writes. Agent time excludes setup and environment retries.
conditions.revisionNote: The same 49 task IDs were evaluated. Terra spans corpus revisions around an environment readiness fix; hashes are preserved per model. Do not treat these as one identical-build cross-model experiment.
conditions.stepAccounting: Agent steps count step/start events (including a started step interrupted by timeout). Tool calls count tool/call events, including failed calls. A step may issue multiple calls; neither metric is a UI click count. There is no step limit.
conditions.pricing: Public API token-price estimates verified 2026-09-17, not actual bills. Terra uses Standard short-context USD; all observed inputs <40k. DeepSeek uses off-peak USD (recorded execution is outside weekday 01–04 and 06–10 UTC); peak rates are also preserved. Hy3 uses TokenHub Guangzhou CNY tariffs converted to USD at 1 USD = 6.7065 CNY (2026-09-16, Cinco Días); all displayed fees are USD. No subscription allocation, free quota, tax, infrastructure, external tool fees or superseded attempts. Cached input is distinct from uncached input; reasoning is included in output. Cache writes are zero in all records; missing write tariff is not assumed free. Incomplete attempts expose recorded subtotals only, never complete cost.
